limitations: Static analysis confirms implemented requests and effects, not successful remote API authorization or execution.
The Python Authenticator POST has no documented Graph creation method. The JavaScript uses a DRS-audience token for Graph device creation. Neither establishes successful registration or MFA bypass.
No execution handoff from the Go wrapper into the appended GravityRAT image was established.
The reviewed entry/task paths do not establish invocation of KillJob or resource-launch helpers. The FileName and Bytes resources contain only a UTF-8 BOM.
Atomscan reports model feature specification v18 versus engine v21. Scores are diagnostic and did not determine judgments.
Cleave reports incomplete source-flow projections for both token scripts. Their complete source paths were reviewed manually.
